descriptions.w3d_f13c_preview_theme_8026b9bc: Builds theme and time-of-day strings from the editor category and FE.Land.Time value, with explicit final enum cases sharing the default branches; resolves the configured resource and checks its game-data type chain; acquires a retained resource interface through a native owned descriptor, assigns the theme for the random-land name and assigns the time string, then releases all interface, descriptor and string lifetimes. Partial layouts and semantic labels are inferred from original strings and instructions.
